rss.title: Building Visual Intelligence — Andreas Blattmann & Dustin Podell, Black Forest Labs
rss.summary: Black Forest Labs’ case for learning AGI from pixels, motion and sound.
rss.text_excerpt:
Black Forest Labs’ case for learning AGI from pixels, motion and sound. Not many people know that Stable Diffusion is why I went fulltime into AI (I aptly titled Multiverse, not Metaverse to call out Zuck’s mistaken investment). It turns out that Dustin Podell also had the same aha moment - quitting his day job when the model came out. But we took very different paths… I stuck to what I knew in human content creation, and Dustin immersed deep into AI content creation with Andreas Blattmann , co-inventor of Latent Diffusion and the rest of the world-leading imagegen crew at Stability AI. Stability fell apart, but Anj Midha helped the core group spin out to BFL, which immediately built an incredible new imagegen model in the Flux series. But why are they now going into video and world models? Andreas gives an example you can try with one hand. If somebody tosses you a ball, your hand starts moving before the ball reaches you. You can do that without being able to write down the trajectory. When he talks about building visual intelligence , that’s the kind of knowledge he means. A still can show you where the ball is. A video shows you how it got there. The sound of impact can tell you when it hit something, even if the camera missed the contact. That’s BFL’s argument for training FLUX 3 on the three signals together. BFL’s FLUX 3 release The horse in motion is one of the FLUX 3 examples we show in the intro. The audio examples are worth playing with the sound on. FLUX 3 Video What a moving camera teaches you Suppose the camera starts in front of a person and pans around them. At some point the model owes you the back of their head. Andreas thinks ordinary two-dimensional video contains a great deal of evidence about what objects look like from other angles. That doesn’t settle whether a model “understands physics,” a point we go back and forth on. It does give you a much better test than asking whether one frame looks convincing. There’s a good engineering example late in the episode. Sharpen each frame of a clip independently and each frame might look terrific. Hit play and the extra detail can shimmer, because the upscaler made a slightly different decision every time. BFL derives its video upscaler from the same FLUX 3 backbone. rss.title: datasette 1.0a43
rss.summary: Release: datasette 1.0a43 I've been leaning hard into Claude Fable 5.2 to help knock things off the 1.0 milestone , which is now 53% complete. The biggest 1.0 item in this release is streaming support for output renderers - the built-in TSV and CSV export mechanisms now use this as well, and plugins can register themselves as capable of streaming every row in a table in one go via the new Response.stream() method. There are a couple of security fixes, one of which I deemed deserving of a GitHub advisory : private stored queries could be exposed, granting access to the title and SQL of the query (but not allowing that query to be executed). There are dozens of smaller improvements. The row page JSON representation finally has a design suitable for 1.0 . A new <datasette-copy-button> Web Component provides copy-schema in various places. JSON in columns on the row page can be pretty-printed. There's a new DatasetteModal.confirm() JavaScript utility method. Plus dozens of bug fixes, including contributions by Zihan Dai , Peter Olkhovets , Ilya Khalafi , and Ankita Advitot . The feature I'm most excited about is a pretty tiny one: I've added CSS multi-page view transitions to Datasette! Here's the commit - key CSS is as follows: /* Enable cross-document view transitions, for anyone without prefers-reduced-motion */ @media ( prefers-reduced-motion : no-preference ) { @view-transition { navigation : auto ; } } /* .facet-results should morph from old position to new */ html : active-view-transition . content > . facet-results { view-transition-name : facet-results ; } /* So should a .table-wrapper, provided it contains .rows-and-columns */ html : active-view-transition . table-wrapper : has ( > table . rows-and-columns ) { view-transition-name : rows-table ; } With that in place, navigations within Datasette - still staunchly a multi-page application - feel more like an SPA. This works on Safari and Chrome at the moment and I believe supports for Firefox is due to land in Firefox 162 on December 8th 2026 (seeing as they are no longer feature-flagged in Firefox Nightly.) rss.title: Open-source AI without Jensen
rss.summary: A decapitation. It’s time to rebuild.
rss.text_excerpt:
The resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is a major setback for the US development of an open model ecosystem. Nvidia still has the financial interests in supporting open models, which are to avoid concentration in power among a few customers who would develop their own chips and reduce Nvidia’s profits, but supporting the open ecosystem is a tricky puzzle more than an engineering problem to grind out a solution on. Nvidia’s business operations are famously extremely dependent on Jensen as an operator, so it is a consensus opinion that there are challenges ahead (or even more high-profile departures through chip-smuggling investigations or plain-old sharks circling more poachable talent). Nvidia’s number one goal is to stabilize the ship, deliver to customers in the next 24 months, and prevent implosion. Open models have been one of Jensen’s more ambitious, founder-style bets. He has been flooding the zone with funding in a way that will very likely dry up. In this period, the open model economy is in its nascency. These are crucial years for establishing use-cases, revenue flow, and motives to continue training the next generation models. I discussed the sensitivity of these early years in my recent talk at Fireworks Forge ( slides , recording ). The core of the argument is one upside for open models, a reason to be optimistic, and one downside. The positive case is that the open model economy has correctly latched onto “ownership of intelligence” and enterprise post-training as a crucial lane. What is to be determined is exactly how big the downstream market is. The downside is that the true long-term benefit of open models, as truly commoditized intelligence, is very far from realization with compute in such short supply. In the near term, where inference startups are also struggling to get enough chips (because Anthropic and OpenAI are buying so much capacity), there’s little margin competition on open-weight models. If open-source models are also served at giant inference margins, as we learned with DeepSeek’s DeepInfer release, they’re far from a commodity. In this paradigm, the closed labs with better economies of scale and integration from model to datacenter and chips will win. I expanded on this challenge in my recent piece on the open model economy . Together, a lot still needs to go right for open models to be a meaningful economic engine. Jens

统一接入多种上游协议：同一个代理服务可同时对接 OpenAI Chat Completions、OpenAI Responses、Claude Messages 和 Codex 风格接口 - 多下游兼容内建：同一个 Provider 不需要额外配置下游格式，默认即可同时服务 `/v1/chat/completions`、`/v1/responses` 和 `/v1/messages` - OAuth 账号文件代理：支持 Codex / Claude 认证文件代理、账号状态记录和账号候选切换；后台提供 Codex 登录、认证文件管理、模型目录维护和配额查看 - Hook 扩展机制：用于补充 Header、请求护栏和成功响应清洗 - 多 Key 池化调度：`auth_group` 支持并发限制、429 冷却、分钟/日请求配额 - 控制平面模型测试：Provider 编辑页可按当前表单快照直接测试模型可用性、首字延迟和 TPS - 后台可直接运维：内置 Provider 管理、Auth Group 管理、OAuth 管理、系统设置、白名单管理、日志和统计面板 - gpt-4.1 - gpt-4.1-mini hidden_model_list: - gpt-4.1-mini ``` 也可以直接从 [config.sample.yaml](config.sample.yaml) 开始裁剪。 注意：下游调用时的模型名不是裸模型名，而是 `provider/model`，例如 `openai-chat/gpt-4.1`。 如果未配置 `providers[].enabled`，默认就是启用状态。 ### 3. 启动服务 ```bash uv run python main.py ``` 或者显式指定配置文件： ```bash uv run python main.py --config path/to/config.yaml ``` ### 4. 验证服务是否可用 访问Web: http://127.0.0.1:8080 查询模型列表： ```bash curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/models ``` 发送第一条聊天请求： ```bash curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/chat/completions \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "openai-chat/gpt-4.1", "messages": [ {"role": "user", "content": "你好，帮我用一句话介绍 LLM_Proxy"} ], "stream": false }' ``` 后台页面始终可访问；如果配置了 `admin.use
